name: Oren Farhi
title: Engineering Leader / Principal Engineer & Tech Lead
summary: Engineering leader with 20+ years of experience building software and the systems around it: architecture, SDLC, quality gates, test automation and release discipline.
Led teams as Head of Frontend Engineering, CTO, tech lead and team lead, and co-founded ReadM, an AI-powered EdTech platform.
Brings a practical point of view on AI-native engineering: what to delegate to AI, what stays human, and which quality controls keep AI-generated code safe to ship.
Drives delivery speed and reliability through build/CI optimization, feature flags, and strong testing culture (TDD/BDD, E2E and visual regression).
Author of Reactive Programming with Angular and NGRX (Springer).
